P1.reason: The explicit financial source profile and separate factory prevent automatic runtime upgrades. Profile-local admission tables preserve existing entry points and previously valid /1 binders.

P2.reason: Literal and dynamic amount/share forms remain distinct nodes with distinct work. UInt256, explicit conversions and all seven new type spellings match the pinned runtime. Width conversion preserves nominal boundaries; same-width conversions remain charged. Arithmetic preserves exact Price orientation, sorted product indices and literal UInt128 scale divisors.

P3.reason: Comma-separated family/tag metadata fits the existing type-argument grammar without general function dispatch. Variant construction and projection infer the exact declared payload types. Unknown tags reject statically with TYPE_NAME; a different active tag rejects dynamically with VARIANT_CASE. some_value preserves Option encoding and OPTION_NONE. The proposal does not imply an unavailable match or refinement facility.

P4.reason: Conditional precedence, right association, whole-tree static checking, lazy reduction, child paths and stated work counts match the runtime. However, the exact false-branch example specifies DIV_ZERO, while the pinned accepted runtime returns ARITH_DENOMINATOR. That diagnostic mismatch prevents approval of the exact proposed behavior.

P5.reason: The proposed closed boundary preserves transport and component limits, phase ordering, trusted financial schema admission, exact one-action signatures, independent ownership and rollback. The separate additive check API must stop before snapshots and reduction. These choices require retaining actual runtime diagnostics; they do not authorize the conflicting DIV_ZERO example identified under P4.

staticMappingAssessment.grammar: The proposed fixed-name alternatives avoid overlap with ordinary primaries when the stated exclusions are applied. Existing numeric type arguments support widths/scales. Conditional grouping and postfix rules are coherent. This is static grammar assessment, not an executed future parser.
staticMappingAssessment.scaleAndWidths: The runtime requires a direct LitUInt width128 divisor equal to 10^scale. Equal-valued locals, conversions and UInt64 literals do not satisfy that predicate. Conversions admit only UInt64/128/256 and check narrowing range.

Independently counting the widening/multiply/divide/narrow expression gives nine entries, ten with Let; floor(4*3/10)=1 supports the proposed output. These are static derivations, not execution evidence.
